description: expiresIn() consults #oldCache before #cache, returning a stale expiry for promoted keys
productionImpact: For any key present in both caches the stale #oldCache expiry is returned instead of the live #cache expiry. Callers scheduling re-fetches based on this value will either refresh too early (wasting backend calls) or too late (serving outdated data past the intended TTL), undermining the reliability of any TTL-driven refresh strategy.
